checks: sample 30-second orbit/edits logs real timings and exact edited input/settings
large 30-second orbit/edits records draw calls, whole-window FPS, latency and main-frame heap
large actual pointer drag records previews, commit and editing frame intervals
viewport rotation/resize is explicitly interrupted and logged
actual JSON download contains all recorded runs
pre-start worker failure prevents a misleading benchmark run
pre-start engine download failure prevents a misleading benchmark run

host.processor: AMD EPYC 9V74; exposed logical CPUs and cgroup limit recorded, not a phone.

reports.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/151.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
limitations: Local diagnostic only; no automatic release pass.
3D latency is commit-to-submitted-draw, not GPU completion or physical display latency.
FPS uses the whole measured window; 2D measures RAF cadence, while 3D counts valid-scene draw submissions. observedIntervalFps is a separate interval statistic.

editingFrameMs selects intervals within 250 ms of a preview. Command timings include attempted commands; committedChanges counts accepted model changes. 2D sufficientInteraction requires at least one accepted change.
Main-frame JS heap is browser-reported and approximate; it excludes worker/GPU/native memory. GPU bytes/time are unknown.
Real-device release evidence needs three uninterrupted five-minute runs after warm-up, complete device/thermal metadata, and Chrome/WebView comparison.
